newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra Graphia, Inalum in 1.6 bln rph deal.
newsitem.headline: Astra Graphia, Inalum in 1.6 bln rph deal.

text.p: Indonesia's information technology distributor PT Astra Graphia said on Thursday it had completed the first phase of a 1.6 billion rupiah project for PT Indonesia Asahan Alumunium (Inalum).
Astra Graphia said in a statement the first phase of the project consisted of the installation of a mainly Digital client/server system for Inalum.

The second phase, which is set to start by the middle of 1997, will consist of implementing the new information system for procurement, inventory and maintenance management systems of Inalum, it said.
Inalum, a joint venture between the governement of Indonesia and Nippon Asahan Alumunium Ltd of Japan, is Indonesia's main alumunium producer.
Astra Graphia distrubutes information technology products including Digital Equipment of the United States, Fuji Xerox of Japan and LG Electronics of South Korea.
